facts.fact: Eswatini's Ministry of Health launched the National Health Intelligence Platform on 16 November 2026, which the minister said will bring clinical, epidemiological, supply-chain and community data into one integrated system.

Eswatini's Ministry of Health launched the National Health Intelligence Platform on 16 November 2026, with harmonised reporting tools and automated data aggregation said to be expected, and no national reporting through it stated.
